relations.text: SPSはTolk発電所で使う石炭のすべてを、TUCOから買っている
relations.text_en: SPS buys all of the coal for its Tolk plant from TUCO

source.label: Xcel Energy 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: SPS purchases all of its coal requirements for its Tolk plant from TUCO Inc. under contracts that will expire in December 2027.

companies.name: コロラド・インターステート・ガス

relations.text: ガスのパイプラインと貯蔵施設を開発して貸す合弁会社WYCOを、CIGと共同で持っている
relations.text_en: Xcel owns WYCO with CIG, a joint venture that develops and leases natural gas pipelines and storage facilities

source.label: Xcel Energy 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: WYCO, a joint venture with CIG, to develop and lease natural gas pipeline and storage facilities.

relations.text: CIGが施設を運営し、PSCoにガスの貯蔵と輸送のサービスを提供している
relations.text_en: CIG operates the WYCO facilities and provides natural gas storage and transportation services to PSCo

source.label: Xcel Energy 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: WYCO leases its facilities to CIG and CIG operates the facilities, providing natural gas storage and transportation services to PSCo under separate service agreements.

relations.text: NSP-ミネソタが、ミネソタ州の新しいグーグルのデータセンターに電力を供給する契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: NSP-Minnesota entered into an electric service agreement to power a new Google data center in Minnesota

source.label: Xcel Energy 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Large Load Agreement — In the first quarter of 2026, NSP-Minnesota entered into an electric service agreement to power a new Google data center in Minnesota.
